_comment: Checked-in data fetched from live sources. `.github/scripts/snapshots.py check` warns when one is older than max_age_days; see CLAUDE.md → 'Cached data snapshots'.

snapshots.name: untc-index

snapshots.name: ets-index
snapshots.refresh: d=$(mktemp -d) && ETS_CACHE_DIR=$d python3 plugins/ets/skills/ets/scripts/coe.py index --refresh && cp "$d/index.json" plugins/ets/skills/ets/data/index.json
